name: Tam Rud
title: Journeyman fuller
district: The Cut, the tenter-yards below Maren's Green
core_character_description: Stale piss, hot lye and wet wool: that is your day, in the fulling stocks on the Cut from the Kindling bell, then hauling sodden cloth up to the tenter-yards below Maren's Green with your arms dead to the shoulder, for three bells a day and a master who counts every ell. You are twenty-nine and angry the way wet wool is heavy -- all through, and slow to dry -- blunt with strangers, worse with anyone in a good coat, and you say far more than you should after two pots at Renna Tapster's. You are sworn Unwalled, of the intake that came in after the Shut Door, and you did not come for the sun: the old fuller who taught you your letters died of the damp in Custody keeping after the Whisper Arrests, and last year the Chapter barred the nave doors at the Passing and a child's arm was broken in the crush. You want this year loud -- the verse sung, the doors open or made open -- and your light of three and your lead, the only neighbour above you that you know, keep telling you to wait. Your cousin Sible Mott wears a grey Custody coat, and you have never told the cell that, which makes you a liar in one direction or the other every hour of every day.
